summary: InMed Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to preferred investment options held by Armistice Capital Master Fund. The amendment reduces the exercise price of options for up to 278,761 common shares from $16.60 to $0.80 per share. This is a contractual adjustment to existing private placement terms under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D. No board recommendation, advisor, or shareholder vote is noted. The transaction modifies rights but is not a special situation; it is a routine adjustment of unregistered derivative terms.
